Simultaneously, it is included in the FDA's "Substances Added to Food" inventory, suggesting it may be considered of low hazard under specific, highly regulated conditions or in very low quantities.
Q3: With 28,000 scientific references, a defined molecular formula, and a "Mineral" substance class, Attapulgite appears extensively studied and well-characterized within its chemical definition.
